# Frontline Courier — Full Site Content for LLMs

Source: https://frontlinecourier.com
Generated for AI crawlers and assistants. Prefer the canonical pages linked in llms.txt.

## Company

Frontline Courier is a courier, cargo and freight forwarding company based in Ambattur, Chennai,
Tamil Nadu, India. The company provides domestic and international courier services, air freight,
surface freight, cargo movement, doorstep pickup, shipment tracking, volumetric weight calculation
and optional transit insurance. It serves individuals and businesses across India and works with
international partners to deliver to more than 220 countries and territories.

Frontline Courier has more than 100 business customers and operates as a hub for courier, parcel
and logistics services. Its stated mission is to provide the best possible delivery experience by
ensuring documents and packages reach their destinations safely, on time and within budget.

Core values: reliability, efficiency and customer satisfaction.
Vision: to become the standard for courier, cargo and logistics services by bringing tracking,
service discovery, volumetric calculation, ratings and reviews into one trusted platform.

## Services

### Domestic courier
Door-to-door delivery of documents and non-documents to major pin codes across India. Options
include surface, air and priority delivery. Doorstep pickup is available. Shipments are tracked in
real time. Indicative transit times range from 1 day within Chennai to 2-8 days for remote regions,
depending on the service selected.

### International courier
Door-to-door delivery to almost every country. Frontline Courier works with DHL, Bluedart, Aramex,
UPS, FedEx, TNT, DPD and other partners. Customs documentation support is available, and transit
insurance can be added at booking. Indicative transit times: Europe 3-6 business days, North America
3-7 business days, Middle East 2-5 business days, Asia Pacific 3-7 business days, Africa 5-9 business
days, South America 5-9 business days. Customs clearance can add time.

### Air freight
Air service is used for time-critical documents, high-value parcels and cargo. Frontline Courier
coordinates pickup, documentation, airline handling, customs and final delivery. Air service is
available for domestic and international routes and can be customised for delicate machinery,
electronics, samples and high-value goods.

### Cargo
Bulk and heavy shipments moved by road across India. Services include customised cargo planning,
experienced handling, real-time tracking and optional insurance. Suitable for boxed cargo,
palletised loads, machinery and specialised equipment.

### Surface freight
Cost-effective shipping for large, non-urgent consignments. Domestic surface delivery uses the
roadway network; international surface freight uses sea routes. Surface courier has a minimum
billing weight of 3 kg. Transit times range from 1 to 8 days domestically depending on distance.

### Priority delivery
- Priority 10:30: next possible business day delivery by 10:30 hours to select pin codes, with
  money-back guarantee. Not available from all origins or to all destinations.
- Priority 12:00: next possible business day delivery by 12:00 hours to select pin codes.
- Priority Next Day: guaranteed next business day delivery for documents and parcels, single pieces
  up to 30 kg, tamper-proof pouch, dedicated handling and support.
- Priority Sunday: pickup before 6:00 PM on Saturday with Sunday delivery on select pin codes.

Priority availability depends on local cut-off times, vehicle arrival times and flight schedules.

## Pricing

All rates are indicative, in Indian rupees (INR), and exclude GST, fuel surcharge and optional
insurance unless stated. The higher of actual weight and volumetric weight is used for billing.
Remote-area charges may apply. A written quote is recommended before dispatch.

Domestic standard rates (up to 5 kg), examples:
- Chennai, surface, 1 day: 250 g INR 22; 500 g INR 32; additional 500 g INR 15.
- Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, surface, 1-2 days: 250 g INR 55; 500 g INR 70; additional 500 g INR 30.
- Andhra, Kerala, Karnataka (excluding Hyderabad), surface, 1-3 days: 250 g INR 65; 500 g INR 82;
  additional 500 g INR 40.
- Hyderabad and Secunderabad, air, 1-2 days: 250 g INR 72; 500 g INR 102; additional 500 g INR 55.
- Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, air, 1-3 days: 250 g INR 77; 500 g INR 107; additional 500 g INR 65.
- North India, air, 1-3 days: 250 g INR 87; 500 g INR 112; additional 500 g INR 70.
- Assam, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Tripura, Andaman and Port Blair, air, 2-5 days: 250 g INR 93;
  500 g INR 130; additional 500 g INR 80.

Domestic air cargo (per kg bands), examples:
- Hyderabad and Secunderabad: INR 105 for 3-10 kg, 11-25 kg and 25-50 kg.
- Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata: INR 125.
- North India: INR 145.
- Assam, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Tripura, Andaman and Port Blair: INR 145.

Domestic surface courier (minimum 3 kg), examples per kg:
- Chennai: INR 22 (3-10 kg), INR 16 (11-25 kg), INR 16 (25-50 kg).
- Tamil Nadu and Puducherry: INR 38 / 27 / 27.

- Hyderabad and Secunderabad: INR 60 / 48 / 48.
- Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata: INR 70 / 58 / 85.
- North India: INR 80 / 68 / 68.

International pricing is provided on request and depends on destination, weight, dimensions, service
level, contents and insurance.

## Volumetric weight

Volumetric (dimensional) weight reflects package density. Courier billing uses the greater of actual
weight and volumetric weight. Measure length, width and height in centimetres, multiply them and
divide by the courier's dimensional factor.

Common formulas:
- Air and international (most partners): (L x W x H) / 5000.
- Some domestic partners: (L x W x H) / 6000.
- Some surface and cargo partners: (L x W x H x 9) / 27000.
- DTDC surface: (L x W x H) / 4750.
- Overnite surface: (L x W x H) / 4000.

The volumetric calculator at https://frontlinecourier.com/service/volumetric-weight-calculation
supports Aramex, Bluedart, DHL, DTDC, FedEx, French Express, Overnite, Trackon, TNT, UPS, SkyKing,
Shree Tirupati, Shree Maruthi, Shree Anjani and Maruthi.

## Booking and pickup

To book, submit the pickup request form at
https://frontlinecourier.com/service/pickup-request or call the booking desk. Provide the pickup
address, delivery address, shipment type (document or non-document), number of pieces, total weight
and delivery location. The team confirms the pickup slot and provides an AWB number after collection.

Quotes can be requested at https://frontlinecourier.com/service/get-quote with contact details,
route, shipment count, weight, dimensions, contents, declared value and classification (commercial,
non-commercial, sample, gift, personal or returnable item).

## Tracking

Track a shipment at https://frontlinecourier.com/track using either a POD/AWB number or a reference
number. The tracking page shows current status, shipment details and status history. Some partner
shipments provide an external tracking link on the courier's website. If no update appears for more
than 24 hours, contact Frontline Courier with the AWB number.

## Insurance and claims

Transit insurance is optional and must be added at booking. Without insurance, no claim can be raised
for loss or damage during transit.

Covered: loss during transit, physical damage during handling or transit, and coverage up to the
declared value subject to policy terms, for domestic and international shipments where declared.

Not covered: prohibited or undeclared items, inherent vice, wear and tear, poor packaging, delays
caused by customs, weather or force majeure, and shipments without insurance.

Claims process:
1. Notify Frontline Courier within 7 days of delivery or expected delivery with the AWB number.
2. Provide photos of packaging and damage, plus an invoice or proof of value.
3. The team reviews documents with the insurer and may request more information.
4. Approved claims are settled according to policy terms.

Useful documents: AWB/tracking number, invoice or purchase receipt, photos of the shipment and
packaging, and a description of the damage or loss.

## Frequently asked questions

How do I book a shipment?
Use the pickup request form or call the booking desk. Share the pickup address, delivery address,
shipment type, weight and preferred service. The team confirms pickup and provides the AWB number.

Do you offer doorstep pickup?
Yes. Doorstep pickup is available in Chennai and across the partner network. Submit a pickup request
with your preferred date.

What items cannot be shipped?
Prohibited items include cash, live animals, hazardous materials, firearms, narcotics and any goods
restricted by the destination country. Declare exact contents when booking.

How do I track my shipment?
Visit the tracking page and enter the POD/AWB number or reference number, or use the search box in the
site header.

My tracking shows no updates. What should I do?
Status scans can take a few hours to appear. If there is no update for more than 24 hours, contact
Frontline Courier with the AWB number.

Can I change the delivery address after booking?
Address changes may be possible before out-for-delivery, subject to courier policy and additional
charges. Contact the team as early as possible.

How is shipping cost calculated?
Cost depends on chargeable weight (actual or volumetric, whichever is higher), distance, service
level and optional insurance.

Is my shipment insured?
Transit insurance is optional and must be added at booking. Without it, no claim can be raised for
loss or damage during transit.

How do I raise a claim?
Notify Frontline Courier within 7 days of delivery with the AWB number, photos of the damage and a
description of the contents.

## Coverage summary

Domestic: Chennai same day (surface, 1 day); Tamil Nadu and Puducherry 1-2 days; Andhra, Kerala,
Karnataka 1-3 days; Hyderabad and Secunderabad 1-2 days; Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata 1-3 days; North India
1-3 days; Assam, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Tripura, Andaman and Port Blair 2-5 days. Surface transit is
longer, typically 1-8 days.

International: Europe, North America, Middle East, Asia Pacific, Africa and South America through
major courier and freight partners. Transit times are indicative and exclude customs clearance.
